title: Vectors: fragmentation test cases
description: Create test vectors for fragmentation. Acceptance: covers various payload sizes, MTU boundaries, used by all implementations.
close_reason: SATISFIED by test/vectors/schc_fragmentation.json (normative RSv3 fixed-profile, hand-derived with independent CRC-32/SHA-256 checks) + test/vectors/schc_fragment.json (generic RFC 8724 §8 codec): payload-size variety via regular_short_tile, 7tiles, single_fragment, multi_fragment; MTU/tile boundaries via profile_capacity and mandatory_receiver_boundary (capacity category, expect ok) and window_boundary; negatives regular_nonzero_padding, all1_without_final_tile, final_window_all0_tile, ack_success_extra_octet, malformed_control, unassigned_bitmap_bit_set, over_profile_capacity (expect packet_too_large), plus schc_fragment mic-failure vector ack_on_error_mic_fail. Machine-consumed by python/tests/test_vectors.py::test_schc_fragmentation_vector_coverage/_integrity/_production_conformance and python/tests/schc/test_fragment.py AND rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs::shared_vectors_drive_production_implementations + tests/shared_vectors.rs::test_schc_fragment_vectors. Ran: cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_vectors.py -k fragmentation -q => 42 passed; cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-schc --features 'std raw-fragment-codec' --test fragmentation_vectors => 1 passed; cargo test -p lichen-schc --test shared_vectors => 3 passed.
